newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of China launches HK$2.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China launches HK$2.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: The following issue has been launched, bankers said on Friday.
BORROWER BANK OF CHINA ACTING THROUGH ITS HONG KONG BRANCH
AMT HK$2 BLN COUPON 1MH+31 BP MATURITY 5 YRS
TYPE FRCD ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCHED 20.JUN.97
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE REPLIES 03.JUL.97
LISTING -- REPAYMENT BULLET DENOMS HK$1 MLN
RATINGS * SALE LMTS -- PAY DATE 17.JUL.97
GOV LAW HONG KONG HOME CTRY CHINA TAX PROV --
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
SNR LEADS HK$200 MLN+ 25 BP ALL-IN 36 BP
LEADS HK$150 MLN 15 BP ALL-IN 34 BP
SNR MGRS HK$100 MLN 10 BP ALL-IN 33 BP
MANAGERS HK$ 50 MLN 5 BP ALL-IN 32 BP
ARRANGER CDFC (HONG KONG)
NOTES *ISSUER HAS PRELIMINARY RATING OF AA-MINUS FROM JBRI.
AN ISSUE-SPECIFIC RATING WILL BE SOUGHT FROM JBRI.
**APPLICATION HAS BEEN MADE TO THE HKMA TO ACCEPT THE
CERTIFICATES AS ELIGIBLE FOR ITS LIQUIDITY
ADJUSTMENT FACILITY.
***MAY QUALIFY FOR FOR HK PROFITS TAX CONCESSSION.
****CMU SETTLEMENT.
-- HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843-6371
